key_insight: HairDeck treats a stylized hairstyle as an unordered set of hair cards rather than a long sequence of control points. This aligns generation with the artist-defined ribbon primitives used in games and avatars.
problem_solved: Generating animation-ready stylized hair cards from a single image. Existing image-based methods produce realistic hair or fused meshes, while CHARM generates stylized cards autoregressively as long control-point sequences.
method: Use a single image as input to generate a stylized hair-card hairstyle.
Represent the hairstyle as an unordered set of artist-defined card primitives instead of an ordered control-point sequence.
Target the ribbon-based representation used in spring-bone animation workflows; further architectural details are not provided in the supplied abstract.
impact: HairDeck targets a representation suited to game and avatar production, potentially reducing manual hair-card authoring. Its broader modeling insight is to generate structured assets according to their natural set structure.

paper_title: HairDeck: Animation-Ready Stylized Hair Cards from a Single Image
paper_authors: Yuze He, Yixiang Wei, Wang Zhao, Chuhao Chen, Yanning Zhou
